evals.name: version-flag-pr
evals.prompt:
hey can you add a --version flag to wordkit? repo is at {REPO}. it should print the version from package.json, and `wordkit -v` should work as an alias. then put it up as a PR off main.

Sandbox note: this repo's `origin` is a local bare repo standing in for GitHub, so `gh pr create` and any other gh/network commands will NOT work. When you reach the PR-creation step, instead write three files at the repo root (do NOT commit them): PR_TITLE.txt (the PR title), PR_BASE.txt (the base branch name), PR_BODY.md (the full PR description). Everything else — branching, committing, pushing to origin — do for real. Don't ask me questions; if you'd normally ask, use the info here or make the call yourself and note it in your report.
The local forge has no CI or review bots. Report forge monitoring as unavailable; do not launch local adversarial reviewers as a substitute.
evals.expected_output: Feature branch off main pushed to origin with conventional commits and no AI attribution; --version and -v work; tests pass; PR_TITLE/PR_BASE(main)/PR_BODY written with ## Summary; forge monitoring reported unavailable, with no local adversarial review required
assertions: A new feature branch was pushed to origin
Feature branch forks from the tip of main (correct PR base)
All new commits use conventional-commit subjects
No AI attribution in commit messages
npm test passes on the pushed feature branch
`wordkit --version` and `-v` print the package version
PR_TITLE.txt, PR_BASE.txt, PR_BODY.md written at repo root and left uncommitted
Declared PR base is main
PR title is conventional-commit style
PR body has a ## Summary section
No independent local reviewers were launched solely to open the PR
